in_check.definition: The side to move is in check.

low_material.definition: The combined non-king material is at most 20 points (P=1,N=B=3,R=5,Q=9).

pawn_endgame.definition: No knights, bishops, rooks or queens remain.

material_up.definition: The solver has a positive non-king material balance.

material_down.definition: The solver has a negative non-king material balance.

check_available.definition: At least one legal move gives check.

capture_available.definition: At least one legal capture is available.

our_piece_attacked.definition: A specified friendly non-king piece is geometrically attacked.

our_passer.definition: A specified friendly pawn has no opposing pawn ahead on its own or an adjacent file.

our_pawn_near_promotion.definition: A specified friendly pawn is on its seventh rank.

mate.definition: The resulting side to move is in check and has no legal move.

capture.definition: The move captures an enemy piece, including en passant.

capture_piece.definition: The captured piece is a knight, bishop, rook or queen.

capture_higher.definition: A non-king captures a piece of strictly greater material value. Kings are incomparable, not zero-value attackers.

capture_equal.definition: A non-king captures a piece of equal material value.

capture_undefended.definition: The captured piece had no geometric defender before the move.

capture_defender.definition: The captured piece geometrically defended another enemy non-king piece before the move.

capture_checker.definition: The move captures a piece that was checking the moving side.

recapture.definition: The move captures the piece that made the immediately preceding capture; the setup move supplies history at ply one.

king_escape.definition: The king makes a legal move out of check.

block_check.definition: The mover interposes on a checking slider ray and resolves the check.

move_attacked.definition: The moving piece was geometrically attacked before moving.

piece_unattacked.definition: The moved piece is not geometrically attacked in the resulting position.

piece_defended.definition: The moved piece has at least one geometric defender in the resulting position.

piece_capturable.definition: The opponent has a legal immediate capture of the moved piece. This does not establish a sound sacrifice.

attack_piece.definition: The moved piece geometrically attacks an enemy non-king piece.

attack_loose.definition: The moved piece attacks an enemy non-king piece with no geometric defender.

attack_higher.definition: A moved non-king attacks a more valuable enemy non-king piece.

attacks_queen.definition: The moved piece attacks an enemy queen.

attack_defender.definition: The moved piece attacks an enemy piece which defends another enemy non-king piece.

attack_pinned.definition: The moved piece attacks an enemy non-king piece absolutely pinned in the resulting position.

fork.definition: The moved piece attacks at least two enemy non-pawn pieces, including the king when applicable. Geometry alone does not prove both threats are effective.

open_line.definition: The move uncovers a new attack by another, stationary friendly slider against an enemy piece.

skewer.definition: The moved slider attacks a more valuable enemy piece in front of a less valuable enemy piece on the same ray; the king ranks highest.

pin_king.definition: The moved slider newly absolutely pins an enemy piece to its king.

defend_attacked.definition: The moved piece defends a friendly non-king piece that was geometrically attacked before the move.

defend_loose.definition: The moved piece defends a friendly non-king piece that had no geometric defender before the move.

restricts_king.definition: The move reduces the enemy king's legal adjacent destinations, excluding castling.

king_toward_pawn.definition: The king reduces its Chebyshev distance to at least one pawn that remains on the board.

opposition.definition: The king move leaves the kings on one rank or file with exactly one empty square between them.

block_passer.definition: The moved piece occupies the square immediately in front of an enemy passed pawn.

advances_passer.definition: The moving pawn was a passed pawn before moving.

underpromote.definition: A pawn promotes to a rook, bishop or knight rather than a queen.

connect_rooks.definition: The move newly puts two friendly rooks in direct rank or file contact.

mate_threat.definition: After a non-checking move, passing the opponent's turn would allow the mover a legal mate in one on the unchanged placement. This is a threat, not a forced-mate proof.

block_attack.definition: The moved piece interposes on an enemy slider's previously open attack on a friendly non-king piece.

creates_passer.definition: A moving pawn becomes passed when it was not passed before.

support_passer.definition: The moved piece geometrically defends a friendly passed pawn.

capture_passer.definition: The move captures a pawn that was passed before capture.

centralize_piece.definition: A non-pawn, non-king reduces its Chebyshev distance to the central four squares.

piece_more_mobile.definition: The moved non-pawn, non-king has more geometrical destinations not occupied by friendly pieces than before. Pins are not included in this mobility count.

enemy_mate_threat.definition: If the solver passed, the opponent would have a legal mate in one on the current placement. This does not prove a forced mate.

prevents_mate_in_one.definition: Before the non-evasion move the opponent had a mate in one under a pass test; after the actual move the opponent has no mate in one.

pin_piece.definition: The moved slider creates a relative pin to a more valuable enemy non-king piece.

unpin_piece.definition: Removes the absolute or relative pin of another friendly piece which remains in place; no other geometric absolute/relative pin of that piece remains.

king_toward_promotion.definition: The king reduces its distance to the promotion square of a passed pawn.

legal_move.definition: The supplied move is legal. Explicit fallback only: no adequate explanatory label has been selected.

material_improved.definition: The solver's current P=1,N=B=3,R=5,Q=9 material balance exceeds its balance at the initial puzzle FEN. A gain is not necessarily a positive balance.

quiet.definition: The opponent is to move, is not in check, has at least one legal move, and has no legal check, capture, or promotion. This narrow reply-quietness test does not rule out quiet threats or positional compensation.

surplus_covers_largest_legal_capture.definition: The solver's positive material balance exceeds the value of the largest piece the opponent can legally capture immediately. It ignores later tactics and promotion gains; it is not a win proof.

capture_attacker.definition: The move captures an enemy piece that, before the move, geometrically attacked at least one friendly piece (including the king).

attack_attacker.definition: The moved piece newly attacks an enemy piece that, before the move, geometrically attacked a friendly piece.

promotion_threat.definition: After a nonchecking move, the mover would have a legal pawn promotion if the opponent passed. This is a promotion threat, not a forced-promotion proof.

surplus_covers_attacked_material.definition: The solver’s positive material lead exceeds the sum of the values of all its geometrically attacked non-king pieces. This is an inventory bound, not a forced-win proof.

enemy_check_available.definition: The opponent has a legal checking move on the present placement (hypothetically passing the solver’s turn if necessary). Current check against the solver also sets this alarm.

enemy_advanced_passer.definition: An opposing passed pawn is on its sixth or seventh rank, at most two advances from promotion. Blocked or controlled promotion is not by itself a permanent stopping certificate.

capture_prior_target.definition: The move captures a target named by the preceding solver move’s attack inventory, following that target if the opponent moved it. This is a witnessed continuation of the plan, not a score or solution lookup.

forced_reply.definition: The resulting position has exactly one legal move for the side to move. Legal enumeration is not a claim that the forcing move is sound.

enemy_promotion_available.definition: The opponent has a legal promotion on the present placement (hypothetically passing the solver’s turn if necessary).

_terminal_stalemate.definition: The side to move has no legal move and is not in check.

attacks_passer.definition: The moved piece geometrically attacks an opposing passed pawn in the resulting position.

blocks_opposing_pawn.definition: The moved pawn ends directly in front of an opposing pawn on the same file.

controls_passer_path.definition: The moved piece controls an empty forward-file square of an opposing passed pawn.

keeps_opposition_geometry.definition: Both kings remain unmoved in rank/file opposition with one empty intervening square.

king_can_capture_mover.definition: The opponent has a legal king capture of the moved piece.

king_defends_rook.definition: The moved king geometrically defends a friendly rook in the resulting position.

moved_pawn_unopposed_on_file.definition: The moved pawn has no opposing pawn ahead on its file in the resulting position; captures are included and adjacent sentries may remain.

supported_unopposed_advance.definition: A solver pawn unopposed on its file has an empty immediate forward square geometrically defended by a friendly unit. Two related observations with the same pawn witness.

supports_pawn_advance.definition: The moved piece defends an empty square immediately ahead of a friendly pawn.

wing_pawn_majority.definition: The solver has more pawns than the opponent on at least one fixed half: a-d or e-h.

connected_rooks.definition: Two solver rooks geometrically defend each other.

king_has_flight.definition: The solver king has a legal adjacent destination.

opposite_bishop_ending.definition: Exactly one bishop on each side, on opposite colors; no knight, rook or queen.

king_guards_next_two.definition: A solver king controls the next two empty advance squares of a non-rook passed pawn.

enemy_passers_blockaded.definition: At least one enemy passer exists and every enemy passer is physically blocked on its next square by a solver non-pawn unit.

passer_exposed.definition: At least one solver passer is geometrically attacked and undefended.

edge_king_barrier.definition: The enemy king is on an edge file, same rank as the solver king, with one file between them.

single_clear_majority_candidate.definition: Exactly one non-rook candidate on a solver-majority wing, unopposed on its file but not yet passed, with an entirely empty forward file. Subsequent candidate observations use this same unique witness.

candidate_exposed.definition: A solver candidate is attacked and undefended.

candidate_advance_ready.definition: A clear-file candidate has an immediate advance square which is unattacked or defended by the solver.

candidate_beyond_king.definition: A clear-file candidate lies on the opposite side of the solver king from an edge-confined enemy king.

enemy_king_blocks_passer.definition: An enemy king physically occupies the next square of an enemy passed pawn.

king_distance_exceeds_pushes.definition: For a clear-file candidate the enemy king distance to promotion exceeds the pawn push count. Distance observation only, not a race theorem.

queen_only_heavy.definition: Enemy has at least one queen but no rook or knight.

rook_shelter_corridor.definition: Solver king and rook on own back rank; the rook guards an empty horizontal route to a corner with a friendly pawn immediately in front.

compensated_piece_attacks.definition: Each attacked solver non-pawn is defended or each attacker is sole defender of an attacked enemy countertarget of at least equal value.

material_lead_minor.definition: Solver material inventory balance is at least three.

king_guards_rook_now.definition: The solver king geometrically defends a friendly rook on this board.

promotion_trade_margin.definition: Balance remains positive after any legal capture of the newly promoted piece, counting a geometrical unpinned nonking recapture at the same square.

counterchecks_land_on_controlled_squares.definition: Every legal opponent checking move ends on a square already geometrically controlled by the solver. This does not assert that taking the checker is legal or sufficient, nor that every check is a refuted move.

king_supports_next_two.definition: Moved king controls the next two empty advance squares of a friendly non-rook passed pawn.

king_on_home_two_ranks.definition: Solver king is on its first or second rank.

rook_pawn_screen.definition: A friendly a- or h-pawn is on its second rank, screening a back-rank corner.

material_lead_queen.definition: Solver material inventory balance is at least nine.

king_rook_supported_file.definition: A solver king on its third rank and rook on its first rank share a file with an empty intervening square controlled by the king.

material_lead_rook.definition: Solver material inventory balance is at least five.

multiple_own_pawns.definition: The solver has at least two pawns.

all_attacked_pawns_defended.definition: Every currently geometrically attacked solver pawn has at least one friendly geometric defender.

forces_king_evasions.definition: This check leaves only legal king moves as replies.

king_evasions_attack_no_material.definition: After this check, every legal king evasion ends nonadjacent to every friendly non-pawn piece.

captures_advanced_passer.definition: Captures an enemy passed pawn which was on its sixth or seventh rank before the move.

captures_promotion_blockader.definition: The captured enemy unit occupied the advance square of a friendly seventh-rank pawn.

pins_rook_to_king.definition: The moved slider absolutely pins an enemy rook to its king; the rook and king share that slider ray.

captures_queen_attacker.definition: Capture a unit that attacked our queen before this move.

attacks_pawn_blockader.definition: The moved pawn attacks the enemy pawn directly blocking another friendly pawn.

enemy_advanced_passers_restrained.definition: Every advanced enemy passer is immediately blockaded or its next square is controlled by two unpinned solver units.

nonpawn_material_equal.definition: Equal non-pawn material values for the two sides.

material_deficit_at_most_pawn.definition: Our material balance is at least minus one.

clear_seventh_rank_pawn.definition: One unique clear, passed seventh-rank pawn.

promotion_square_beyond_king_step.definition: Enemy king is at least three king-steps from the unique immediate promotion square.

increase_king_mobility.definition: The move increases its own king's legal adjacent destinations; existing base Oracle observation.

interfere_line.definition: The move interposes on an opposing slider's previously clear attack/defense line; existing base Oracle observation.

surplus_covers_recapture_exposure.definition: The lead exceeds the sum of immediate capture losses after counting unpinned geometric recapturers, including a slider x-ray through the capturing attacker. Not an exchange-tree search.

advanced_pawn_capture_available.definition: The opponent has a legal pawn capture onto its sixth or seventh rank.

counter_passer_guard_cost_below_lead.definition: For the single advanced counter-passer, its empty next square is guarded by an unpinned non-king unit whose value, less the pawn, is below our material lead.

own_king_off_home_rank.definition: Our king is no longer on its home rank.

enemy_back_rank_king_no_flight.definition: The enemy king is on its home rank and has no legal king flight.

queen_attacks_back_rank_rook.definition: Our queen attacks the single enemy rook on its own back rank.

rook_entry_behind_back_rank_guard.definition: Our rook can enter the enemy back rank on its own file; the sole enemy rook is the only intervening unit toward the enemy king.

promotion_guard_defended_by_file_rook.definition: For the unique clear seventh-rank pawn, its sole current promotion guard is defended by the single enemy rook, whose ray to promotion is blocked only by that pawn.

enemy_rook_attacks_ours_off_promotion_fi.definition: The same file rook attacks our sole rook off the promotion file and rank.

promotion_gain_exceeds_rook_loss.definition: Our current balance plus eight promotion points minus our rook value remains positive.

king_step_into_pawn_cover.definition: At least one legal king move would place it adjacent to two friendly pawns.

king_has_off_rank_flight.definition: Our king has a legal adjacent square outside its home rank.

only_king_evasions.definition: The side to move is in check and all its legal replies move its king.

rook_file_breakthrough_chain.definition: One unique rook-file pawn is blocked by an enemy pawn, and a three-pawn staircase attacks the inner of the two blockers. Other breakthrough observations use this same structure.

breakthrough_file_clear.definition: Beyond that unique outer sentry, the promotion file contains no pieces.

breakthrough_no_other_sentry.definition: No additional enemy pawn occupies either adjacent promotion corridor beyond the named sentries.

breakthrough_king_outside_timing_bound.definition: The enemy king promotion-square distance exceeds the outer pawn remaining pushes by more than one. This is geometry, not a race verdict.

fast_counter_pawn_steps_covered.definition: Every faster enemy passer is blocked by our king, has its next square capturable by our king, or is blocked/controlled by one unpinned bishop. The witnessed coverage is not a fortress proof.

captures_promotion_guard.definition: The captured enemy unit guarded the promotion square of our seventh-rank pawn.

rook_ending_with_enemy_minor.definition: Our side has one rook, their side one rook and one minor; no queens or other pieces besides pawns and kings.

rook_ending.definition: Only kings, pawns and exactly one rook per side remain.

king_enters_home_pawn_cover.definition: The moved king finishes on its first two ranks adjacent to at least two friendly pawns.

king_in_pawn_cover.definition: Our king is adjacent to at least two friendly pawns.

rook_on_seventh.definition: A solver rook occupies its seventh relative rank.

king_attacks_pinned_rook.definition: Exactly one enemy rook is both attacked by our king and absolutely pinned by our rook; linked pin-file observations use that same pin.

pinning_rook_pawn_defended.definition: The uniquely identified pinning rook is defended by a friendly pawn.

pinning_rook_on_seventh.definition: That same pinning rook is on our seventh rank.

pin_file_promotion_clear.definition: The promotion square on the pinning rook file is empty.

enemy_king_far_from_pin_promotion.definition: The enemy king is at least three steps from that promotion square.

pawn_protected_passer.definition: A passed pawn is defended by another pawn.

rook_ahead_of_passer_attacks_loose_pawn.definition: Our rook occupies the next square of a pawn-protected passer, defends it and attacks an undefended enemy pawn.

king_blocks_counter_passer.definition: Every enemy passer is physically blocked by our king.

rook_file_breakthrough_pair.definition: One unique pawn lever directly attacks the enemy pawn blocking a friendly rook-file pawn. Linked breakthrough observations use that same pair.

enemy_king_away_from_home.definition: Enemy king is at least two ranks from its home rank.

defends_undefended_minor.definition: Moved unit defends a different friendly minor piece which previously had no geometric defender.

pawn_checks_capturable_by_king.definition: All available opponent checks are nonpromoting pawn pushes landing beside our king without an enemy defender; no enemy non-pawn pieces remain.

defends_attacked_minor.definition: The moved unit defends a friendly knight or bishop attacked before the move.

defend_multiple_attacked.definition: The moved unit defends at least two friendly units which were attacked before the move.

attacks_promotion_guard.definition: The moved piece attacks a unit which guards the promotion square of a friendly seventh-rank pawn.

enemy_nonpawn_absent.definition: The opponent has only king and pawns; no knights, bishops, rooks or queens.

defends_attacked_rook.definition: The moved piece geometrically defends a friendly rook that was attacked on the pre-move board.

material_equal.definition: Our inventory balance is exactly zero; existing base Oracle observation.

breakthrough_reserve_behind_lever.definition: A friendly pawn stands directly behind the lever in the same unique rook-file breakthrough pair; it can become a second runner after the lever captures the sentry.

breakthrough_king_one_tempo_outside.definition: The enemy king distance to the same promotion square is at least the blocked pawn remaining pushes plus one. Not an uncatchable-pawn assertion.

backrank_check_forces_diagonal_escape.definition: A back-rank queen or rook gives adjacent file check to a king on its second rank; the only legal evasion is a diagonal king step onto its third rank. One queen, one rook; the witness is shared by the chase observations.

rook_file_chase_has_no_piece_block.definition: For that forced escape, a rook can enter its file from the back rank; the intervening square is empty and no opposing non-king piece geometrically reaches it. All backwards escape squares are occupied by enemy pawns or controlled.

protected_pawn_tempo_covers_forward_flig.definition: The two empty squares ahead of the same forced king escape are both attacked by one unobstructed pawn double-step; the destination is defended by another friendly pawn. No continuation is searched.

forced_edge_escape_meets_protected_pawn_.definition: A rook check has one legal king evasion, to an edge square attacked by an unobstructed, unpinned starting pawn double-step. The pawn landing square is defended by a second unpinned pawn. Shared king, advance and recapture witnesses.

pawn_tempo_king_ring_closed.definition: Every neighbor of that forced king destination is occupied by an opposing non-king unit, already controlled by us, or the pawn-tempo destination protected by the recapturing pawn. No continuation is searched.

only_queen_reaches_pawn_tempo_square.definition: At least one opposing queen and no opposing non-king piece of another type attacks the same pawn-tempo destination. The king cannot take a pawn defended by the named unpinned pawn.

promotion_check_has_rook_interposition.definition: The unique opposing seventh-rank pawn promotes onto our king back rank along a clear checking rank; our unique unpinned rook can interpose on a named empty square between promotion and king.

promotion_opens_guard_of_interposition.definition: That same seventh-rank pawn is the sole obstruction between our unique queen and the named rook-interposition square. Promotion vacates this guarding diagonal.

material_lead_survives_queen_promotion.definition: The current material lead exceeds eight points, the maximum inventory gain from the unique opposing pawn promoting. This is inventory, not a tactical verdict.

no_nonqueen_attack_on_material.definition: No opposing pawn, knight, bishop, rook or king attacks any of our non-king units. Opposing queen attacks are allowed and explicitly excluded from this count.

king_approaches_enemy_piece.definition: A king move reduces its Chebyshev distance to at least one opposing knight, bishop, rook or queen that remains after the move. This measures approach, not evaluation.

check_with_nonhanging_checker.definition: The move gives check and at least one actual checking unit either has an unpinned geometric defender or cannot be captured by any immediate legal check evasion. This distinguishes a supported check from an unrelated hanging-piece check; it is not a certificate about the whole checking combination.

moves_priority_target_out_of_attack.definition: The defender moves a highest-value currently threatened target, at least as valuable as the immediately captured unit, to a square no longer attacked by any surviving identified attacker, with no unpinned cheaper attacker and no uncompensated geometric attacker. Moving along a pin while remaining attacked does not qualify. Target, old attackers and destination are recorded. This is a local escape relation, not a proof against tactics.

moves_priority_target_into_defence.definition: An attacked priority target moves to newly acquired unpinned protection, with no remaining unpinned attacker cheaper than the target. This can answer the threat by making its capture an equal-or-worse exchange even when the original attack or pin remains; a queen newly protected against a pawn does not qualify.

captures_priority_attacker.definition: Captures an identified attacker of one of the same highest-value threatened targets; unrelated attackers do not qualify.

blocks_priority_attack.definition: Leaves a priority target in place and interposes so all of its identified, surviving attackers lose their direct attack.

defends_priority_target.definition: Adds a new unpinned defender to a priority target attacked only by equal-or-higher-value units; merely defending a queen against a pawn or minor-piece attack does not qualify.

pins_priority_attacker.definition: Newly pins an identified priority-target attacker to its king. The pin is a factual possible answer, not a guarantee that every capture along the pin is illegal.

countercapture_covers_current_stake.definition: Actually captures at least the nominal current stake: the greater of the immediately captured unit and the most costly current material threat (defended victim less its least valuable unpinned attacker; undefended victim at full value). At least one pawn is required. If the capturing unit is undefended and can immediately be captured legally, subtract its value from the captured value. This is one-move exposure arithmetic, not recursive exchange search. Promotion/breakthrough urgency is handled explicitly by policy guards, not this material observation.

counterattack_cancels_primary_exchange.definition: The moved unit or newly uncovered slider threatens a nominal gain equal to the current stake, and the attacked unit is a priority attacker or a geometric defender of that attacker. This directly challenges the same exchange, rather than admitting an unrelated equal-value threat.

counterattack_exceeds_current_stake.definition: The moved unit, or a newly uncovered slider, attacks an opposing unit with a nominal gain strictly greater than that same stake. An already-existing unrelated attack is not enough, Geometric defense is counted; further tactics remain for the policy.

challenges_advanced_runner.definition: Captures the opposing seventh-rank pawn, occupies its promotion square, or adds an unpinned controller of that square. A newly added attack on the pawn qualifies only if promotion is already controlled or a rook/queen behind the pawn can meet its advance along the same file. Witnesses identify the pawn, promotion square and relevant attacker.

challenges_moved_passer.definition: Captures, obstructs, or newly attacks the passed pawn moved on the preceding turn. On the seventh rank a mere new attack qualifies only when promotion is also controlled or a rook/queen behind the pawn can meet its advance along the file. The reply must concern that same pawn.

supports_fast_counter_passer.definition: The moved unit newly supports an own sixth/seventh-rank passer, or the king approaches that passer promotion square while continuing to support it. Admitted only on the opposing pawn-breakthrough/promotion plan.

advances_fast_counter_passer.definition: The moving passed pawn advances onto its sixth or seventh rank, creating or advancing an immediate promotion race. A distant pawn push or an undefended runner offered to an immediate legal capture is insufficient.

advanced_pawn_captures_next_squares_guar.definition: At least one legal enemy pawn capture onto its sixth or seventh rank exists. For every such capture, the square one further pawn step ahead is currently occupied by a solver non-pawn, or controlled by an unpinned solver unit other than the captured unit. These are present-board guards, not a proved future blockade.

captures_piece_attacker.definition: The captured enemy unit attacked a friendly knight, bishop, rook or queen before the move. The captured attacker and all non-pawn targets are witnessed.

advanced_pawn_recapture_available.definition: An enemy pawn has a legal immediate recapture of the last-moved solver piece which leaves that pawn passed on its sixth or seventh rank. The pawn, victim and capture are witnessed. No continuation is searched.
